rules.message: There is a CLI for ttt — call scripts/ttt <group> <verb> (e.g. scripts/ttt client <slug>, scripts/ttt db master "SELECT ...") instead of writing a program to import it.

meta.note: arm only after the CLI ships; a nudge toward a tool that does not exist is how callusguard's fetch-dead-domain rule raised failures 7%→17%
